get.summary: WebSocket (Upgrade; the upgrade itself is answered before the ordinary sign-in, because a browser cannot send a header, and signs in by its first message). The first message is {"type":"auth","token":...}; the token is never in the address. Then only the caller's own `notification`, `count` and `approval` events, a ping every 25 seconds. Capped per person and per tenant.
